positions.title: Business Analyst II
positions.description:
Primary Roles:
1. TIME PeopleSoft Administrator - Timesheet reporting, Work Schedules Administration, Business Process Documentation, Enhancement and Defect Reporting, Policy Application, Trainer for other Business Analysts. 
2. ePay System Administrator - Travel Expense Reporting, Travel Management, Policy Application, Business Process Documentation, Defect and Enhancement Reporting. 
3. AnyDoc OCR System Administrator - Optical Character Recognition Configuration, Infiniworx Workflow, ExchangeIt Data Table Mapping, Imaging and Batch Data. 
4. OnBase System Administrator - Document Repository, Workflow and Document Configuration, Approval Notification, SQL and C# scripting, Software Development LifeCycle and Upgrades. 
5. ServiceNow Citizen Developer - ServiceNow System Administration, Application Development, JavaScript scripting, Office of the Chief Financial Officer point of contact. 
6. Fiscal Year End Manual Receipts Closing Lead - Receiving Manual Receipts, Reconciliation of Purchase Order Accruals, Development and Presentation of Training Materials to Field. 
Secondary Roles:
1. Business Systems Analyst Trainer and Interim Lead Responsibilities
2. JIRA and Confluence POC for Upgrades and Enhancement
3. Financial Services Help Desk Backup

positions.title: Business Analyst I
positions.description:
Primary Roles:
1. LITE Administrator - Timekeeping System Administrator, Alternate Work Schedule, Business Process Documentation, Audit and Reconciliation of Reported Leave Types, Time sheet Reporting, Application of Federal, State, Local Labor Laws. 
2. ServiceNow Power User - Office of the Chief Financial Officer Point of Contact for ServiceNow Configurations, Access, Dashboard Creation, Data Reporting. 
3. Fiscal Year End Manual Receiving Receipts
4. TIME Upgrade Support Primary Contact - User Acceptance Testing, Process Documentation, Go Live Call Center Support. 
Secondary Roles:
Financial Services Help Desk Support Backup - Help Desk Support, Customer Service, Support Request Management.
Infor ePay System Administrator - Expense Reporting and reimbursement, Travel Management, Travel Policy 
Major Projects:
1. ServiceNow Email Conversion Integration and OnBoarding for Human Resources
2. Time sheet audit for COVID Pay and Authorized Leave
3. Accounts Payable Erroneous Payments Report
4.TIME PeopleSoft Oracle Upgrade Support
5. Electronic Funds Transfer Backup and Auditor

positions.title: Pr. Accounting Assistant
positions.description:
Primary Roles: 
1. Financial Services Help Desk Agent: assisted internal and external customers with Financial Services including;
Payroll - Pay Stubs, paycheck inquiry, discrepancies, re-issues
Time Reporting - Exempt vs. Non-Exempt Policy, Labor Laws, Davis-Bacon, Data Entry Resolution
Accounts Payable - Payment Status, Hold Clearing, Banking Updates
Travel Accounting - Reimbursement Status, Policy, Payment Requests
Tax Compliance - W2's, W4, various tax forms, Tax Laws
 Accounts Receivable - Invoice Payments, Invoice Policy
 Project Accounting - Expense Routing, System Resolution and Configuration
Systems Supported: PeopleSoft, TIME, Oracle EBS, Infor - ePay, Hyland OnBase, Ceridian, ServiceNow, Cisco Finesse, Lab Internally developed systems
2. Electronic Funds Transfer Coordinator: Supported AP operations with verification of vendor/employee banking updates, data entry into Oracle EBS, returned funds, auditing, fraud reporting. Directly worked with FBI, CIA, GSA for fraud coordination and reporting. Developed streamlining processes leveraging existing system capabilities. 
Secondary Roles:
1. ServiceNow PowerUser: System Administrator for all Finance related groups within ServiceNow. Ensured system maintenance, catalog changes, up to date contact information for desks, creation and maintenance of service request types, automation of workflows. Developed automated email intake for vendor AP operations that were converted into a ticket. Member of Quality Review Board and General Steering committees. 
2. Conference Auditing - assisted Travel Accounting in auditing conference reimbursement over payments and incorrect reporting. 
3. Erroneous Payment Report Development - Assisted AP operations with development of Erroneous Payment Report for DOE reporting. 
4. Reporting metrics to C-Suite and all levels of Finance for strategic operational decisions. 
5. Fiscal Year End Reporting
Received 2 110% awards and 2 Directorate Awards for project work.

positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description:
Administrative Assistant to the University Registrar.
• Performed general secretarial and assistant duties such as calendar maintenance, supporting
staff, logistics, marketing, and internal communications.
• Coordinated staff meetings and events across campuses of Stockton, Sacramento, and San
Francisco.
Budget manager for the Office of the University Registrar. Budgetary responsibilities include
ordering office supplies, furniture, revenue tracking, expense reports, projections, labor
tracking, Electronic Personnel Action Forms, physical labor requests, optimization of budget
practices, credit card expense reconciliation, check disbursement, invoice tracking, journal
entries, budget transfers and travel expense reconciliation. Creation of budgetary proposals for
division resource allocation to student labor, computers, and software accounts.
• Knowledge and application of Federal, State, School, Labor, accessibility and confidentiality laws
such as FERPA, HIPPA, ADA Compliance, etc. Reviewing contracts, independent contractors,
vendor setup and knowledge of business policies of the university for compliance.
• Content management for departmental website. Versioning updates and modifications for
forms, policies, and practices.
• University wide communications and hospitality arrangements across campus for events with
external and internal visitors to office for Administrative Program Review including vicepresidents,
deans, administrative support staff, faculty, advisors, equity programs and students.
• Data-Entry into Banner Database for student, faculty and staff, including transfer course
articulation, advisor assignment, degree auditing maintenance, etc.
• Assisted Commencement in tracking degree awarding, invoices of physical diplomas, logistical
deliveries and materials.
• Project management of office expansion and workstations in synchronization with other
building departments. Liaison for Voter Registration, Military/Veteran and LGBT+ groups.

positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description:
Find, research and test information technology solutions for optimal efficiency in office. 
Presentation and training office workers with new solution technologies. 
Web Design and Development of Office Site with Site Analytics.  
Implementation of POS/Inventory System with general ledger records in Excel. 
Creation  of Employee Database in Access, with data entry and extrapolation.

positions.title: Decision Science Tutor
positions.description:
Tutor students in applied mathematics to make data-driven decisions in business settings:
1. Finite Math: Linear Programming, Simplex Methods, Matrices, Linear Regression, Probability, Applied Calculus, Finance, Cost-Volume-Profit Analysis, Real Analysis, Focus in Excel

2. Business Statistics: Data Reconciliation and Analysis, Probability, Hypothesis Testing, Inferential Statistics, ANOVA, Chi-Square, Non-Parametric Methods, Focus in Excel

positions.title: Computer Concepts Tutor
positions.description:
Tutor students in computer concepts of:
1. Microsoft Office Applications: Word, Powerpoint, Excel, Access
2. Basic Front End Web Design: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery
3. Basic Google App tools: Drive, Sites, Dev Tools, Android
